title: A Classification of Multiply Monogenic Quartic Orders
summary: We study two-times monogenic quartic orders; i.e., those of the shape $\mathbb{Z}[α] = \mathbb{Z}[β]$, with algebraic integers $α$ and $β$ not $\mathbb{Z}$-equivalent. Two specific types, describing possible algebraic relation among monogenizers of two-times monogenic orders were defined by Bérczes, Evetrse, Győry, who proved under certain conditions on the Galois group of the normal closure of a given number field $K$, that there can be only finitely many two-times monogenic $\mathbb{Z}$-orders in the ring of integers $K$ which are not of these specific two types.
